name: Meetinghouse Dental Care
description: Private mobile-first concept for Meetinghouse Dental Care, grounded in its official identity and first-party visual source.

directionContract.thesis: Meetinghouse Dental Care should feel immediate, composed, and unmistakably itself on a phone.
directionContract.ownWorld: image first editorial system drawn from the exact identity and first-party project material.
directionContract.story: Move from orientation to care question, source context, visual proof, and a direct official action.
directionContract.firstViewport: Exact identity, one clear proposition, a first-party image, and one thumb-ready action.
directionContract.form: Mobile-first care practice homepage with an ink-resolved identity finale.

hero.headline: A calmer route to the right next step.
hero.sub: Meetinghouse Dental Care deserves a first screen that makes the next step legible without flattening the character of the work. This private concept begins with the official identity and first-party source material.

offerings.heading: A homepage organized around the decision a visitor is actually making.
items: Understand the role of Meetinghouse Dental Care without searching through the page
See first-party visual context before choosing the next care question
Reach the official source through one direct, clearly labelled action

story.heading: Identity and evidence lead. The interface follows.
paragraphs: Meetinghouse Dental Care is the premier provider of integrative, biologic, and whole-body dentistry in a leading-edge, high technology facility in Hatboro, PA. Whole-food nutritional counseling.

This concept treats the source material as visual evidence, not decoration. The composition gives each image room to establish scale and character while the written hierarchy stays concise enough for a phone.
No testimonial, result, price, award, schedule, or service promise is added here. Current operational details remain under the control of the official website.

experience.heading: A deliberate path from first impression to official action.
items: Readable source-led narrative with decisive image rhythm
A consistent action that stays reachable without interrupting the page

gallery.heading: First-party source material, recut for a mobile editorial rhythm.

feature.heading: The page disappears behind the work, then returns to the identity.
feature.text: As each section passes, progressive motion lets completed information soften without turning the page into a scroll experiment. The final scene resolves the exact Meetinghouse Dental Care logo over a code-native ink field, crisp on every phone density.

catalog.heading: Three useful routes, kept honest and direct.

items.title: Review current services and project information
Confirm current location and contact details
Decide whether the next care question makes sense

contact.heading: Current details belong to the official source.
contact.sub: This private concept does not collect or send information. Use the official Meetinghouse Dental Care website to confirm services, availability, hours, and direct contact details.

closing.heading: A stronger first impression, resolved to the exact mark.
